INSERT INTO public.todos (id,title,done) VALUES (1,'Buy milk',false),(2,'Read book',false),(3,'Walk dog',true) RETURNING id,title,done
UPDATE public.todos SET done=true WHERE id=2 RETURNING id,title,done
